limitations: Scenario arithmetic, not a forecast, premises offer or proof of market prices/demand.
Operating result covers the supplied costs only, before unmodelled taxes, depreciation, interest and other excluded costs; it is not net profit or cash flow.
Startup funding includes deposit, inventory and reserve; not all items are expenses/CAPEX. Initial inventory is not added again to monthly variable costs as a separate expense.
No cash-flow schedule, payback, loan/repayment model, seasonality or working-capital turnover is calculated. Reserve does not prove funding adequacy after launch.
Source attestation is supplied by the caller, not independently verified by this service.
Selected zone is an unverified context reference; OSM score has no numerical effect.
